mapper.update: UPDATE t_task_run SET status=#{status}, stage=IFNULL(#{stage},stage),progress=#{progress}, started_time=IF(started_time IS NULL AND #{status}!='QUEUED',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,started_time), finished_time=IF(#{status} IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELED','DEAD'),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,finished_time), error_message=#{errorMessage}, result_json=IF(#{resultJson} IS NULL,result_json,CAST(#{resultJson} AS JSON)), retry_count=IF(#{status}='FAILED',retry_count+1,retry_count) WHERE task_code=#{taskCode}
mapper.select: SELECT task_code taskCode,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId, task_type taskType,task_name taskName,target_type targetType,target_code targetCode,status,stage,progress, trigger_type triggerType,triggered_by triggeredBy,retry_count retryCount,max_attempts maxAttempts, payload_json payloadJson,result_json resultJson,error_message errorMessage,next_attempt_at nextAttemptAt, started_time startedTime,finished_time finishedTime,created_time createdTime,updated_time updatedTime FROM t_task_run WHERE task_code=#{taskCode}

SELECT task_code taskCode,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId, task_type taskType,task_name taskName,target_type targetType,target_code targetCode,status,stage,progress, trigger_type triggerType,triggered_by triggeredBy,retry_count retryCount,max_attempts maxAttempts, error_message errorMessage,started_time startedTime,finished_time finishedTime,created_time createdTime FROM t_task_run
ORDER BY created_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT status,COUNT(*) total FROM t_task_run WHERE (knowledge_base_id=#{kb} OR #{kb} IS NULL) AND created_time>=DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY status
